This module is deliberately separated from **tace** and can be directly ported as a whole to other packages.

You should note that the contents of this module are **different from those in**
[cartnn](https://github.com/xvzemin/cartnn).  
The code in the **cartnn** repository is generally **no longer actively updated**.

If you wish to use **irreducible Cartesian tensor products** in a manner similar to
**e3nn**, you may refer to the implementation in the **cartnn** repository.
However, please be aware that **this style of usage is not recommended in practice**.

In contrast, this module will **continue to evolve with the needs of tace**, while
making a best effort to remain **directly transferable to other packages** for
broader reuse by the community.

For details on **Cartesian-3j**, **Cartesian-nj**, and the construction of the
corresponding **precomputed Cartesian product basis**, see:  https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.16882
